purpose: Pre-registered independent audit of a completed sharded PCQM4Mv2 geometry production v2 release with v3 self-contained auditor, runtime provenance, and report-payload integrity. The gate fully checks the release envelope, partition, and content-addressed motif dictionary, then decodes a deterministic stratified sample without importing producer feature or payload implementations.

permitted_dependencies: published production and payload JSON contracts

execution_provenance.auditor_script_rule: Hash the exact standalone v3 script before the audit and require identical bytes and SHA-256 before plan creation, before report creation, and after exclusive report write.
runtime_required_fields: libc name and version or the explicit token unknown
execution_provenance.runtime_version_rationale: The audit may run on the CPU host or the later 4090 host. Exact observations are evidence, but differing valid versions are not by themselves a release failure.
execution_provenance.report_payload_hash_projection: canonical JSON of the complete report object after removing only report_canonical_payload_sha256

full_streaming_checks: completed shard directories and manifest roots are contiguous and complete
every declared artifact byte count and SHA-256 matches disk
membership covers every selected ordinal exactly once in ascending order
membership dispositions close exactly against reject-ledger or payload-index rows
LMDB keys equal admitted membership storage keys one-for-one and in canonical order
every motif-census row has exactly motif_lexeme_sha256, motif_fragment, and count
every motif_lexeme_sha256 equals SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 motif_fragment without normalization
one digest never maps to distinct motif fragments within or across shards
shard motif censuses aggregate exactly to the global content-addressed motif dictionary and counts
the logical release root recomputes from the published configuration and shard roots
one E3FP parameter hash is used across all admitted shards

admitted_sample_selection.ranking_material: canonical JSON of seed, release_id, shard_index, ordinal_band, and record_storage_key
admitted_sample_selection.preregistration_rule: semantic_review_plan.jsonl is fsynced before any LMDB value is fetched or decoded

sampled_payload_checks: payload byte length and SHA-256 equal payload-index
magic, header length, canonical JSON, exact fields, native-array descriptors, contiguous blocks, and block SHA-256 obey payload v2
logical record hash equals payload header, payload-index, and admitted membership
atom projection map is ordered and in range
motif atom groups are a nonempty exact partition
ordered motif_lexeme_sha256 is a closed SHA-256 sequence with the same cardinality as motif_atom_indices
every sampled motif digest resolves in the audited global motif dictionary
coordinates are finite float32 with shape model_atom_count by 3
E3FP is int32 with shape model_atom_count by 4 and obeys the structural range/padding rules
geometry remains a non-trainable pretokenizer candidate
reject_review_requirement: Every reject is listed for a later independent source and feature semantic recomputation; this envelope gate does not relabel a reject.
